bundle.shortDescription: Turn 3D shapes into flat sheet parts
bundle.longDescription: Sheetform turns any 3D shape into flat parts you can laser-cut or CNC-cut from sheet material, with numbered holes, joinery, nesting and DXF/SVG/PDF export.
